MailGeorge01: Had some spare stones lying around the yard.^Maybe you'll find some use for them.^Don't waste them.^ ^-George
MailGeorge02: Evelyn insisted I send this to you. Said it's good to share food with the neighbors.^There's some parsnips and mushrooms in there. Nothing special, but it'll do.^ ^-George
MailGeorge03: Found some decent vegetables around the house.^You work too hard... probably ought to eat better, too.^ ^-George
MailGeorge04: Thought you might like these hashbrowns. Evelyn baked fresh bread too.^Don't tell her I said this, but they turned out pretty good.^ ^-George
MailGeorge05: You've been coming around here quite a bit lately.^Figured I'd send some honey and an omelet. Simple food's better than all that modern junk anyway.^ ^-George
MailGeorge06: These fried mushrooms taste better than they look.^And cheese never hurt anybody. Just don't eat it all at once.^ ^-George
MailGeorge07: Coffee helps on the days when my legs don't want to cooperate.^And those pepper poppers warm you up on cold days. Maybe you'll like them.^ ^-George
MailGeorge08: Evelyn made pumpkin soup today.^Told her to save some for you before Alex showed up and ate everything.^ ^-George
MailGeorge09: You've been working too hard.^A proper meal helps more than running around like a lunatic all day.^ ^-George
MailGeorge10: Never thought I'd get this used to having you around town.^Set aside some leeks for you. They're my favorite.^And a complete breakfast too. You've earned a decent meal after everything you've done.^ ^-George
